description: Objective: provide the missing daemon-current safe-release authority from which an expansion planning hold can be created without trusting an agent's `DAEMON_VERIFIED` fields. Missing, foreign-project, stale, active/draining, terminal-incomplete, conflicting, malformed, or unreadable records return typed ABSENT or UNKNOWN with stable exact code and layer and no release evidence.
